extensionDescription.message: AI-powered instant speech translation for all video meetings. Break language barriers with real-time voice translation.

clickToStart.message: Click "Open MAO Chat" below to start real-time translation.

quickStartInstructions.message: Configure your API key (OpenAI or Gemini) → Select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" as microphone → Start speaking!

gatherTownGuidance.message: Za korištenje MAO Chatja, odaberite "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" u postavkama mikrofona.

wherebyGuidance.message: Za korištenje MAO Chat, molimo odaberite "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" u postavkama mikrofona i onemogućite smanjenje buke za bolje performanse.

defaultGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat, please select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings.

discordGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat, please select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings and disable Noise Suppression in Discord's Voice settings for better performance.

slackGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat in Slack Huddles, please start a Huddle, then select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" in your Video and Mic settings, and disable Noise Suppression in Audio & Video preferences for better performance.

teamsGuidance.message:
Ako ne vidite potpuni popis audio uređaja u postavkama Teamsa:
1) Privremeno onemogućite MAO Chat proširenje i osvježite stranicu
2) Dozvolite Teamsu pristup mikrofonu i kameri kada budete upitani
3) Ponovo omogućite MAO Chat proširenje i osvježite stranicu ponovno
4) Dozvolite MAO Chatju pristup mikrofonu kada budete upitani. Sada biste trebali vidjeti i stvarne uređaje i "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" u postavkama.

jitsiGuidance.message: Za korištenje MAO Chat u Jitsi Meet, otvorite Settings > Devices i odaberite "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" kao svoj mikrofon. Zatim otvorite Advanced audio settings i onemogućite Noise suppression, Echo cancellation i Automatic gain control za jasan prevedeni zvuk.

unsupportedHeadline.message: MAO Chat još nije dostupan na $HOSTNAME$.

desktopCtaBody.message: Sistemski virtualni mikrofon za OBS, YouTube, Twitch i bilo koju desktop aplikaciju. Windows · macOS · Linux.

browserSitesHeading.message: Više volite preglednik? MAO Chat radi na ovim stranicama — kliknite za otvaranje:

detectFailBody.message: Osvježite stranicu i ponovo otvorite MAO Chat.
